name: @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/browser-demo
description: Browser demo for Solana AI agents that sign through installed Wallet Standard wallets.

scripts.build: pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/core build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/ios-link build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/wallet-standard-web build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/mwa-mobile-web build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/workflow build && vite build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/core build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/ios-link build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/wallet-standard-web build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/mwa-mobile-web build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/workflow build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
